issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: azure_bluet, dandelion, cornflower, oxeye_daisy, cauldron, oak_hanging_sign, oak_sapling, birch_sapling, spruce_sapling, bee_nest, moss_carpet, green_wall_banner.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.detail: Capped at 1: L3 adds only props (flowers along the path, two bee nests, two banners, two potted saplings on a shelf, moss, a hanging sign the viewer does not draw), no clearly visible new feature or job.
notes.levels: L2 and L3 are hard to tell apart in the sheet; the bee nests are hidden under the canopies and the shelf is inside the shed.
notes.roof: Automatic overhang warning is a false alarm.

visual.summary: L2 plus flowers along the path, bee nests on the oaks, green banners and a small shelf of potted saplings in the shed, moss on the log pile and a hanging sign at the gate.
problems: L3 adds no clearly visible new feature or job over L2: add one that reads at a glance, e.g. a proper sapling nursery bench/cold frame beside the shed, a log-drying rack or a timber cart, or a second growth stage (a row of half-grown trees) in the plantation.

Leaves of the two young oaks run into the shed eave: leaf at (8,5,6) sits on the roof stair and leaves at (2,3,6)/(8,3,6) press against the shed posts, so from the front the canopies swallow the shed; trim them back so the eave at z=6 is clear.

Shed interior is a 3 x 1 alcove (x4..6, z8) holding chest, grindstone and barrel in a row: reads as a stall more than a woodcutter's shed; give it a real working depth (2 deep) or turn it into an open-fronted lean-to with a bench.

Reach: the shed floor, workstation (chest, grindstone, barrel), yard and every planting row are reached; the unreached places are roof slopes, leaf tops, pier tops and the gateway roof, which is fine.

notes.levels: The new lean-to drying shed over the log yard shows in iso and back views (last round's 'no new feature' problem is fixed). Also new: banners by the shed door, flowers and potted saplings.
notes.artefacts: Ignores Carlton's v1 note: the sapling spots must be clear and decoration moved outside the plot. The beds still hold fake young trees (log + leaves), and props stand inside the plot. The back edge of the lean-to roof hangs in the air (see problems).
notes.purpose: Five flowers are added inside the plot, against Carlton's note.
notes.roof: False alarm on the roof warning (see L1).

visual.summary: Level 3: L2 plus a lean-to drying shed over the log yard, green banners at the shed door, a hanging sign in the gateway, a shelf of potted saplings in the shed, flowers along the path and moss on the logs.
problems: Ignores Carlton's v1 note: the sapling spots must be clear and decoration moved outside the plot. The beds still hold fake young trees (log + leaves), and props stand inside the plot.

Carlton's v1 note (all levels) is not met: sapling spots must stay clear, and decoration belongs outside the planting area. L3 adds flowers inside the plot at (4,0,1), (6,0,1), (6,0,2), (4,0,3) and (6,0,3), on the verges next to the planting rows. Put them outside the fence or in a bed by the shed.

Lean-to roof: its high back edge, slabs at (7..9,4,9) and (7..9,4,10), has nothing under it. The post (8,0..1,10) stops two blocks short and (7..9,2..3,10) is air, so from the back the roof floats. Carry the post up to y3, with dark oak logs at (8,2,10) and (8,3,10) (better: posts at x7 and x9 too), or slope the roof down toward the back.
Same sapling spacing and fake-tree problems as L2.
Reachability: fine. The shed, the yard, the path and the beds are reached; the log-pile top under the lean-to (7..9,2,8..9) is not, which is fine.

notes.artefacts: Carlton's note is met (plot holds only dirt rows and saplings; the new flowers are outside the fence at x0, x12..13 and z0). But the drying lean-to's high back edge still floats, now in its new place: see problems.
notes.detail: Lean-to, banners by the door, hanging sign at the gate, flower pots on a shelf, moss, flowers along the fence.
notes.levels: New visible feature: the lean-to drying shed over the log pile, plus flowers round the fence, banners and the gate sign.
notes.roof: Shed roof fine; the automatic overhang warning is a false alarm. The lean-to's support problem is counted under artefacts.

visual.summary: L3 adds a lean-to drying shed over the log pile, green banners by the shed door, a hanging sign under the lychgate, a shelf of flower pots, moss and a ring of flowers outside the fence.
problems: Lean-to back edge floats (last round's issue, moved, not fixed): the old post at (8,0..1,10) is gone because the lean-to moved to x16..18, z3..6, but it only has posts at the low front (spruce fences (16,0..2,3) and (18,0..2,3)). The high back slabs (16..18,4,5) and (16..18,4,6) have air under them at y3, and the log pile below reaches only y1 (y2 only at (17,2,6)), so from the side the back of the roof hangs in the air, touching the stairs (16..18,3,4) only at an edge. Add back posts, e.g. spruce fences at (16,2..3,6) and (18,2..3,6) standing on the logs (and (17,3,6) on the log at (17,2,6)), or stack logs up to y3 under the back row.
Minor: the shelf pots (14,3,11) and (16,3,11) are empty flower_pot blocks; the description promises potted saplings (potted_oak_sapling / potted_spruce_sapling) if the mod can place them.
Reachability: fine. Shed, yard, path, all rows reached; unreached are only roof slopes, the lean-to roof and the pier and gateway tops.
